metadata.title: PERSEUS CONUS forest yield curves: FIA hybrid + recalibrated growth projections (48 states, five stock metrics, twelve scenarios)

creators.name: Weiskittel, Aaron
creators.affiliation: University of Maine, Center for Research on Sustainable Forests

metadata.description:
One-hundred-year projected forest stock trajectories for the 48 conterminous United States, derived from USDA Forest Inventory and Analysis (FIA) plot data with the PERSEUS hybrid yield-curve engine. Five stock metrics (above-ground live carbon, above-ground dry biomass, live stem volume, merchantable volume, merchantable bole biomass) are projected at the state level from 2025 to 2125 in 10-year steps, under twelve management and disturbance scenarios.

Stocks are projected on a hybrid Chapman-Richards growth curve with a senescence decline tail, recalibrated to the FIA longitudinal remeasurement increment and capped at the 95th percentile of observed standing stock, fit per forest-type by EPA level-3 ecoregion by ownership cell. Managed scenarios apply an owner-typical harvest regime to a FIADB-derived fraction of the land base (observed harvest share for business-as-usual and conservation, plantation share for intensive), with FIA reserved (protected) plots excluded; this calibrates harvest intensity to the observed landscape rather than a whole-landscape rotation. Disturbance-exposed and mortality-stressed variants apply FIA-calibrated disturbance and density-mortality drags.

This is the data layer behind the PERSEUS Forest Intelligence dashboard (https://holoros.github.io/perseus-forest-intelligence). Source code, decision records, and methods notes are at https://github.com/holoros/perseus-forest-intelligence. Underlying FIA data are public domain (USDA Forest Service).
